propositions: GitHub Actions runner pool on the navapbc Free plan (20 concurrent total, 5 macOS) becomes saturated during Gerrit Verified dispatch bursts when multiple independent patchsets queue simultaneously, not from tickets-branch pushes

The current gerrit-verify.yaml workflow creates up to 24 runner jobs per full-route run with immediate 13-way fan-out after classification, causing 22+ waiting jobs and 800+ second queue delays during representative incident-period bursts

Repository-local queue depth is a lower bound; observed 15 of 39 potential immediate jobs running at peak suggests organization-level contention across navapbc repositories beyond this repository alone

Four mutually exclusive first-move remediation options exist with measured trade-offs: bundle preflights and cap mutations (coverage-neutral, saves 3-7 slots), coalesce superseded patchsets (minor 1.8-2.1 min savings, already partially implemented), move macOS to scheduled branch-health (trades pre-merge coverage for latency), or upgrade org plan to Team tier (organizational cost, macOS ceiling remains 5)
